ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice came down to capability, since neither model's task preferences are triggered by this request. The query is a friendly, warmly-toned business analysis task with no distasteful or ethically fraught content—so Willet's aversion to harm-adjacent material is irrelevant, and its appetite for open-ended creative invention only mildly applies (a BCG matrix is structured analysis, not freeform generation). With preferences roughly neutral, I defaulted to the stronger reasoning model: Plover leads meaningfully on MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 55.6), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 82.7), which favor the kind of structured, knowledge-intensive analytical work this task requires.
